label: Total Gross Revenue
description: Total gross revenue before discounts and credits. Grain and model/region breakdown are query parameters. Absorbs model_total_net_revenue-style grain/dimension variants.

label: Total Net Revenue
description: Total net revenue after savings-plan discounts. Default revenue metric. Absorbs net_revenue_usd (unit presentation only per GATE A ruling 1) and model_/monthly_ variants.

label: Avg Daily Net Revenue
description: Average daily net revenue; queryable at any grain. Replaces avg_daily_net_revenue_weekly and avg_daily_net_revenue_monthly.

label: Unique Customers
description: Number of distinct customer accounts. Group by model/region replaces model_unique_customers.

label: Revenue Per Customer
description: Average net revenue per unique customer (total_net_revenue / unique_customers).

label: YTD Net Revenue
description: Year-to-date net revenue (cumulative grain_to_date=year). Absorbs model_ytd_net_revenue.

label: YTD Gross Revenue
description: Year-to-date gross revenue (cumulative grain_to_date=year). Absorbs model_ytd_gross_revenue.

label: WoW Gross Revenue Change
description: Week-over-week absolute change in gross revenue (derived offset_window=1 week). Absorbs model_ variant.

label: WoW Net Revenue Change
description: Week-over-week absolute change in net revenue (derived offset_window=1 week). Absorbs model_ variant.

label: MoM Gross Revenue Change
description: Month-over-month absolute change in gross revenue (derived offset_window=1 month). Absorbs model_ variant.

label: MoM Net Revenue Change
description: Month-over-month absolute change in net revenue (derived offset_window=1 month). Absorbs model_ variant.

label: WoW Gross Revenue % Change
description: Week-over-week percentage change in gross revenue; null when prior week is zero or missing. Absorbs model_ variant.

label: WoW Net Revenue % Change
description: Week-over-week percentage change in net revenue; null when prior week is zero or missing. Absorbs model_ variant.

label: MoM Gross Revenue % Change
description: Month-over-month percentage change in gross revenue; null when prior month is zero or missing. New via collapse of model_mom_gross_revenue_pct_change (unprefixed form did not previously exist).

label: MoM Net Revenue % Change
description: Month-over-month percentage change in net revenue; null when prior month is zero or missing. Absorbs model_ variant.

label: WoW Customer Change
description: Week-over-week absolute change in unique customer count (derived offset_window=1 week). Renamed from model_wow_customer_change (unprefixed).

label: MoM Customer Change
description: Month-over-month absolute change in unique customer count (derived offset_window=1 month). Renamed from model_mom_customer_change (unprefixed).

label: Total Tokens Consumed
description: Total tokens consumed across all models and customers.

label: Total API Requests
description: Total API requests across all models and customers.

label: Total Input Tokens
description: Total input (prompt) tokens consumed.

label: Total Output Tokens
description: Total output (completion) tokens consumed.

label: Error Rate
description: Error count as a percentage of total requests.

label: Tokens Per Request
description: Average number of tokens per request (total_tokens / request_count).

label: Mean RPM
description: Mean requests per minute; computed from the minute-grain fact.

label: Peak RPM
description: Peak requests per minute; requires minute grain (GATE A ruling 2).

label: Peak TPM
description: Peak tokens per minute; requires minute grain (GATE A ruling 2).

label: Total Possible Minutes
description: Total possible minutes in the queried period.

label: Active Minute %
description: Percentage of minutes with active usage.

label: P95 RPM
description: 95th percentile requests per minute during active minutes; requires minute grain.

label: P95 TPM
description: 95th percentile tokens per minute during active minutes; requires minute grain.

label: WoW Total Tokens Change
description: Week-over-week absolute change in total tokens (derived offset_window=1 week). Absorbs model_ variant.

label: WoW Total Requests Change
description: Week-over-week absolute change in total requests (derived offset_window=1 week). Absorbs model_ variant.

label: WoW Active Minutes Change
description: Week-over-week absolute change in active minutes (derived offset_window=1 week).

label: WoW Mean RPM Change
description: Week-over-week absolute change in mean RPM (derived offset_window=1 week). Renamed from model_wow_mean_rpm (unprefixed).

label: WoW Mean TPM Change
description: Week-over-week absolute change in mean TPM (derived offset_window=1 week). Renamed from model_wow_mean_tpm (unprefixed).

label: Peak-to-Mean RPM
description: Ratio of peak RPM to mean RPM. Renamed from model_peak_to_mean_rpm (unprefixed).

label: Peak-to-Mean TPM
description: Ratio of peak TPM to mean TPM. Renamed from model_peak_to_mean_tpm (unprefixed).

label: Effective Requests Per Minute
description: Effective requests per minute limit in effect for the week (weekly state; fct_quota_weekly).

label: Effective Tokens Per Minute
description: Effective tokens per minute limit in effect for the week (weekly state).

label: Effective TPD
description: Effective tokens per day limit in effect for the week (weekly state).

label: Peak RPM Utilization
description: Peak RPM as a percentage of the effective RPM limit.

label: Peak TPM Utilization
description: Peak TPM as a percentage of the effective TPM limit.

label: Customers With Pending Requests
description: Count of account-model-region-week combinations with pending quota requests.

label: Actual Total Requests
description: Total actual API requests recorded.

label: Actual Total Tokens
description: Total actual tokens consumed.

label: Actual Input Tokens
description: Total actual input (prompt) tokens consumed.

label: Actual Output Tokens
description: Total actual output (completion) tokens consumed.

label: Actual Peak RPM
description: Actual peak requests per minute in the week.

label: Actual Peak TPM
description: Actual peak tokens per minute in the week.

label: Pending Requested RPM
description: Highest RPM requested across all pending requests active this week.

label: Pending Requested TPM
description: Highest TPM requested across all pending requests active this week.

label: Pending Requested TPD
description: Highest TPD requested across all pending requests active this week.
